# Sandbox bridge probe

Version 0.1.0. Install as a community package and enable it in a session. Select
Bridge reader or Bridge input from the view menu, then allow the labelled page
capabilities. Both are ordinary views and use the same public page root.

The page displays public story, human input context and supported interactions.
Submit sends a player action, Answer submits the displayed interaction, Write
note invokes this package's manual runtime through proposal commit, Stop calls
the host abort and Open notes opens its own panel. Refused submissions keep the
draft. The host return and permission controls remain outside the frame.

Consent is device-local and bound to the complete resolved spec and every
published asset. Changed content asks again. Return and revoke retire the port;
Retry reloads declarations and rechecks consent. This fixture has no surface
replacement, heartbeat, network requests or dependencies. Server handlers and
schemas stay outside the public UI root. Tests/configuration live outside this
package. No model calls are needed for its manual runtime.
